text: Ask accounts to connect their AI assistant each time they open a space, until connected or declined three times
description:
Felix 2026-11-20: "We want to more actively ask the user to connect their assistant. Offer MCP! When user registered, and opens a space, offer it! When he opens a space next 3 times, offer it again and again. Only stay silent when clicked away for the third time."

Built: a card in the bottom-right corner (McpOffer.vue) after a space finishes loading, with Connect (opens the MCP dialog) and Not now; it does not time out. Silent once the account holds a non-browser token (an MCP client) or after three "Not now". Counted per browser, server and account (localStorage). Claude recommended the card over a blocking dialog; open whether to open the dialog right away on the first space after sign-up.

status.comment: 6d5e706d (2026-11-20). Evidence: frontend McpOffer.spec.ts (offered on each space open until three dismissals, silent with an assistant connected, Connect opens the dialog). Whether people connect more: not observed yet.
